recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly, close-up portrait of a man with a defiant expression, wearing a human skull as a crown adorned with flat, graphic sunflowers. The style blends realistic facial rendering with expressive, rough brushstrokes and flat vector-like floral elements.
coreVisualRelationships: The skull sits directly atop the head, acting as a symbolic crown.
Contrast between the detailed, warm-toned skin and the desaturated, translucent skull.
Juxtaposition of harsh urban elements like bandages and tattoos with soft, bright yellow sunflowers.
The dark, gestural background frames the face to emphasize the central vertical axis.
coreInvariants: Heavy, visible brushwork in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, large-scale bust portrait occupying 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose, highlighted by warm directional lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves upward to the skull crown, then follows the sunflowers and background brushstrokes downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-contrast black and white gestural brushstrokes in the corners and sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the background and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre, sienna, and terracotta skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and muted pink for the flowers; lime green for floating petals.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background highlights and the dark subject; saturation is concentrated in the face and flowers.

letterConstructionRules: Tattoo-style lettering on the face (small, thin strokes)
Signature-style script in the margin (vertical, fluid, ink-like)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters must appear integrated into the skin texture or as part of the canvas surface
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Minimalist hand-drawn accents to maintain focus on the illustration.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital painting of a man with warm skin tones and bandages on his face, wearing a translucent skull crown with flat yellow sunflowers. Use a background of black and white expressive oil brushstrokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, thin-line 'SPC' tattoo lettering on the forehead and a vertical black ink signature in the bottom right margin.

verificationChecks: Is the skull translucent enough to see the hair through it?
Are the sunflowers flat and graphic compared to the painterly face?
Does the lighting on the face feel warm and directional?

mustRedesign: Specific facial likeness to avoid IP infringement
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the skull crown is properly seated on the head.
Check that the bandages follow the contours of the face.
Verify the background doesn't distract from the central portrait.
Confirm the color palette remains cohesive and earthy.
Check for the presence of the floating green petal accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + [Symbolic Headwear] + [Graphic Floral Accents] + [Gestural Oil Background]
